title: Balanced brackets
prompt: Implement `static bool IsBalanced(string s)` — true when every bracket in s (only `()[]{} appear`) closes in the correct nesting order. "([)]" is NOT balanced.

tests.name: normal
tests.hint: A stack: push openers, pop and match closers.

tests.name: edges
tests.hint: Empty string, closer-first, and dangling openers.
